1. **[SSO and SCIM](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/sso)**: Set up SAML/OIDC single sign-on and SCIM directory sync so your team signs in through your identity provider and access stays in sync.
2. **[Ask](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/ask)**: The `/support/ask` agentic support API, which diagnoses failed jobs and integration issues and returns actionable fix parameters.
3. **[Crawl](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/crawl)**: Recursively discovers and scrapes every reachable subpage of a site, handling sitemaps, JS rendering and rate limits.
4. **[PII Redaction](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/pii-redaction)**: Replaces personally identifiable information in scrape and parse markdown before it goes to agents, logs or vector stores.
5. **[Threat Protection](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/threat-protection)**: An organization-controlled policy, enforced server-side, that blocks requests to risky URLs across every endpoint.
6. **[Deep Research](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/alpha/deep-research)**: A legacy v1 alpha research API, being deprecated in favor of the Search API and the Deep Research use case.
7. **[Research Index](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/research)**: A purpose-built index for research agents, with tools to search papers, read full-text passages and find related work.
8. **[JSON mode](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/llm-extract)**: Uses an LLM to extract structured fields from a single URL. For multiple URLs or discovery, other tools are recommended.
9. **[Scrape](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/scrape)**: Turns any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown, handling proxies, caching, rate limits and JS-heavy content.
10. **[IP Restrictions](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/ip-restrictions)**: Restricts a team's API keys to an allowlist of IPs or CIDR ranges, enforced server-side on every authenticated request.

Because of the 10-page cap, other pages under `/features` may exist that weren't fetched. I wrote these summaries from each page's title, description and opening text, not from the full content.
